en_title: Robert Pattinson's James Bond Casting Process Details Revealed by Amazon's Jeff Bezos
cn_title: 亚马逊的Jeff Bezos披露罗伯特·帕丁森出演詹姆斯·邦德的选角过程细节
opus_summary: 亚马逊创始人杰夫·贝索斯透露，下一部007电影的选角最终确定了五名候选人，并为每人安排了三场试镜。导演Denis Villeneuve等人观看试镜后，一致倾向于选择罗伯特·帕丁森。贝索斯表示，团队最初因帕丁森已十分出名而略有顾虑，但他的试镜表现十分突出。

paragraphs.en: Amazon founder Jeff Bezos, who purchased MGM Studios in 2022 and assumed full control over the James Bond 007 franchise last year, shared details on the casting process and how the creative leads, including the director of the next 007 film Denis Villeneuve, ended up choosing The Batman and The Odyssey actor Robert Pattinson as the next James Bond .
paragraphs.cn: 亚马逊创始人Jeff Bezos于2022年收购了米高梅影业，并于去年获得詹姆斯·邦德007系列的完全控制权。他分享了选角过程的细节，以及包括下一部007电影导演丹尼斯·维伦纽瓦在内的创作主创最终如何选定《新蝙蝠侠》和《奥德赛》演员罗伯特·帕丁森出演下一任詹姆斯·邦德。

paragraphs.en: Speaking at an event with media company Semafor, Bezos spoke for a couple of minutes on the Bond casting process (hat tip: Steve Jurvetson ), saying he was "heavily involved" before detailing how it came down to Pattinson. "We ran a really tight process," he said. "We made the final decision on Friday. We down-selected to five finalists and then we did real old-fashioned screen tests of those five finalists. And it was really interesting. Full costume, real sets, other actors with them. We did three different scenes with each of the five finalists and then we got together on Friday to spend a couple of hours looking at all of the screen tests.
paragraphs.cn: 在媒体公司Semafor举办的一场活动上，Bezos花了几分钟谈论邦德的选角过程（感谢Steve Jurvetson），称自己「深度参与」了选角，随后详细说明了帕丁森如何最终胜出。「我们的选角流程非常严谨，」他说，「我们在周五做出了最终决定。我们筛选出了五名最终候选人，然后为他们进行了真正的传统试镜，非常有意思。他们穿着全套戏服，在真实布景中，还有其他演员与他们搭戏。我们让五名最终候选人每人演了三个不同的场景，然后在周五聚在一起，花了几个小时观看所有试镜录像。

paragraphs.en: "All of the actors were extraordinarily talented. By the time we got to this list of five, they were all amazing. But there was something special about Rob Pattinson and his performances. And it was immediately undebated. Denis, we all gravitated towards Rob."
paragraphs.cn: 「所有演员都才华横溢。到了这份五人名单上的时候，他们个个都很出色。但罗伯特·帕丁森和他的表演有一种特别之处。这立刻就成了毫无争议的选择。丹尼斯，我们所有人都倾向于罗伯特。」

paragraphs.en: Bezos and his team did question it for a bit, though. "Initially, I would say we were slightly biased a little against him just because he's already so famous," he explained. "We sort of thought maybe we should have somebody a little more unknown. But in the screening tests it was so obvious: he is James Bond."
paragraphs.cn: 不过，Bezos和他的团队确实曾短暂地对此有所疑虑。「我会说，起初我们对他稍微有一点偏见，只因为他已经太出名了，」他解释道，「我们有点觉得，也许应该找一个不那么出名的人。但在试镜中，答案非常明显：他就是詹姆斯·邦德。」

paragraphs.en: Interestingly, after Bezos asked fans who they'd like to see as the next James Bond last year, Superman actor Henry Cavill won the popular vote. Instead, of course, an actor who has played DC's other ultra-famous superhero got the gig. Unfortunately, though, it stands to reason that Pattinson might not continue as Bruce Wayne and Batman after 2028's The Batman Part II.
paragraphs.cn: 有趣的是，去年Bezos询问粉丝希望谁出演下一任詹姆斯·邦德后，超人扮演者亨利·卡维尔赢得了大众投票。不过，最终获得这一角色的当然是一位曾出演DC另一位超级知名超级英雄的演员。遗憾的是，据此推测，帕丁森在2028年的《新蝙蝠侠Part II》之后可能不会继续出演布鲁斯·韦恩和蝙蝠侠。

paragraphs.en: It's been a heck of a year for Pattinson, certainly, between starring in The Odyssey, Primetime, The Drama, and next month's Dune: Part 3; filming The Batman Part II; and landing the role of Bond.
paragraphs.cn: 对帕丁森来说，这一年无疑非同寻常：他主演了《奥德赛》《Primetime》《The Drama》以及下个月上映的《沙丘3》；拍摄了《新蝙蝠侠Part II》；还拿到了邦德这个角色。

paragraphs.en: Ryan McCaffrey is IGN's executive editor of previews and host of IGN's weekly Xbox show, Podcast Unlocked , and a co-host of Next-Gen Console Watch . He's a North Jersey guy, so it's "Taylor ham," not "pork roll." Debate it with him on Twitter at @DMC_Ryan .
paragraphs.cn: Ryan McCaffrey是IGN的预览内容执行编辑、IGN每周XBOX节目《Podcast Unlocked》的主持人，也是《Next-Gen Console Watch》的联合主持人。他是北新泽西人，所以那叫「Taylor ham」，而不是「pork roll」。可以在X上通过@DMC_Ryan与他讨论这个问题。
